name: Witch Doctor: Spirit Link Idol equalizes nearby party members' health every 2 sec (#1891)
contract: #1891 filed Spirit Link Idol 500993 under the Necromancer, but 500993 is SpellFamilyName 19 with no
description: it is the EffectTriggerSpell of 500992 'Spirit Link Idol' (PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL,
amplitude 2000 ms, 14 s), the timer of the Witch Doctor talent Spirit Link Idol 706369
(CharacterAdvancement 13133, ClassType 15 = class 13, level 50). 706369 summons creature 522106 and reads
'Drop a Spirit Link Idol for $500992d. The idol redistributes the health of all party and raid members
every 2 sec, such that each player ends up with the same percentage of their maximum health.'
The server implements the pulse in the idol's creature AI (npc_ascension_witch_doctor, entry 522106),
not through 500993, so the audit's 'id not in source' premise does not show a missing mechanic.
Two grouped level-60 Human Witch Doctors with equal maximum health M and regeneration disabled: the caster
at full health and the ally at 1 health. The first pulse leaves both at (M + 1) / 2, about 50%; after the
ally is dropped to 1 health again, a later pulse leaves both at about 25%.

steps.label: PRECONDITION: both players have the same maximum health
PRECONDITION: the caster is at full health
PRECONDITION: the ally is nearly dead
The Spirit Link Idol is summoned
DISCRIMINATING: a pulse raises the ally to the shared 50%
DISCRIMINATING: the same pulse lowers the caster to the shared 50%
DISCRIMINATING: a later pulse raises the ally to the shared 25%
DISCRIMINATING: the later pulse lowers the caster to the shared 25%
